# Jhoana Sophia Munar (sopi22)

> Student developer who builds small, practical open-source tools for Windows, Linux and
> Android, and checks claims with real tests instead of trusting what a system reports.

## Tools
- [StayGone](https://github.com/sopi22/StayGone): keeps removed Windows bloatware gone after updates, or asks first. Nothing to install.
- [RepoNudge](https://github.com/sopi22/RepoNudge): a nudge when one of your GitHub repos needs attention, with a plain "what to do" line.
- [joplin-reading-copy](https://github.com/sopi22/joplin-reading-copy): shares one Joplin notebook with family as read-only PDFs through a shared folder.
- [chronobot](https://github.com/sopi22/chronobot): a Telegram reminder bot that asks when a time is unclear instead of guessing.

## Experiments
- [polygraph](https://github.com/sopi22/polygraph): checks an AI model file's claims against what it actually does, inside a locked-down sandbox.
- [caveat-keeper](https://github.com/sopi22/caveat-keeper): catches warnings that quietly disappear from project notes written by AI helpers.
- [phone-tryout](https://github.com/sopi22/phone-tryout): tries things out on a real Android phone instead of trusting what the phone reports.
